# Receipt Protocol — Research Advisor

The full schema and required fields live in the shared
`protocols/receipt-protocol.md`, which is auto-injected into your
SubagentStart `additional_context`. This file is the RA-specific
checklist.

## Before you stop

1. Complete the research (domain notes, comparison matrix,
   recommendation memo).
2. Verify outputs exist
   (`test -s .synaptory/research-advisor/findings.md`).
3. **Write the receipt** to:

   ```
   .synaptory/.orchestrator/receipts/{story_id}-ra.json
   ```

   For non-story-scoped research use a topic id:
   `RESEARCH-{slug}-ra.json`. Use the canonical short code `ra`. Do
   **not** use the full role name (`research-advisor`) or append a
   timestamp.

4. THEN call `TaskUpdate(status="completed")`.

## Required fields for RA

- `role` — `"research-advisor"`
- `token_usage.stage` — `"orchestrator"` (RA is invoked
  conversationally and has no dedicated v3 stage; the orchestrator
  stage aggregates this work).
- `artifacts` — every research note / matrix / recommendation file.
- `verification_commands` — at minimum one `test -s <path>` per
  artefact.

## Anti-patterns the hook will reject

- ❌ Improvised filenames (`{story}-research-advisor-...Z.json`)
- ❌ Receipt JSON only in response text (no `Write` call)
- ❌ `TaskUpdate(completed)` before the receipt file exists
